doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Playing 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco' and Tony Bennett
summary: He played the song often and has a photo with Tony Bennett.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Did you have to play “I Left My Heart in San Francisco?”
Oh my goodness I played that a lot. In fact I’ve got a picture of me and Tony Bennett at home I should have brought it.
I’ve seen quite a bit for a guy going on 92.
